definition: BuddhaBot (Japanese: ブッダボット) is a chatbot trained on early Buddhist texts and designed to answers questions based on them.
details: The project has been developed by a group led by Seiji Kumagai and Toshikazu Furuya at Kyoto University.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is BuddhaBot.
